vulnerable_statements.reason: The parent profile's directory dentry may be NULL (e.g. the parent's fs entries were never created or were already removed). This value is not checked.

The possibly-NULL parent dentry is passed straight to aafs_create_dir. The child directory then gets created under the wrong place (the securityfs root) or the parent inode is dereferenced as NULL. The result is stored in prof_child_dir(p), which can lead to a NULL pointer dereference or inconsistent dentry state later.

suggested_fix: After dent = prof_dir(p), check whether dent is NULL. If it is, set error = -ENOENT and goto fail2 instead of calling aafs_create_dir with a NULL parent. More generally, check that every parent dentry is valid before creating child entries under it.
